report-text.query: SELECT rpad(rpad(lss.PLANT_NAME,8),11)|| rpad(rpad(SUM_NET_QUANTITY,5),6)|| rpad(lss.SAP_MATERIAL_TXT,15) as TEXT FROM ( SELECT lss.PLANT_CD, lss.PLANT_NAME, lss.SAP_MATERIAL_NO, lss.SAP_MATERIAL_TXT, round(SUM(lss.NET_QUANTITY),0) as SUM_NET_QUANTITY, lss.BASE_UOM_CD FROM ulgn01.VLGNC_REP_LOAD_SHIPPING_STATS LSS WHERE ({0}) AND ({1}) GROUP BY lss.PLANT_CD, lss.PLANT_NAME, lss.SAP_MATERIAL_NO, lss.SAP_MATERIAL_TXT, lss.LANG_CD, lss.BASE_UOM_CD) LSS ORDER BY lss.PLANT_CD, SUM_NET_QUANTITY DESC
